standard_prerequisites: The action of the affine Grassmannian elements W_{C_n^(1)} on core partitions via the raised operators s_i^{C_n^(1)} (section 5 setup).
The set C_{2n}^s of self-conjugate 2n-cores and the notion of removable nodes of a partition.
core_obligations: W_{C_n^(1)} . empty = C_{2n}^s: the affine Grassmannian elements of type C_n^(1) are parametrized by the self-conjugate 2n-cores.
proof_roadmap: Stability: one first checks that C_{2n}^s is stable under the action of W_{C_n^(1)}.

Descent: for any nonempty c in C_{2n}^s there exists at least an integer i in {0,...,n} such that all i and 2n-i nodes of c are removable because c is self-conjugate; hence s_i^{C_n^(1)} . c = c' with c' != c in C_{2n}^s of strictly smaller size, and iterating reaches the empty core.
difficulty_reason: 1095-1103把自共轭core稳定性与成对可移节点结合，构造严格减小分拆的仿射作用下降直到空core，从而证明参数化的满射。保留C型这一目标；同法B型变体作为作品内关联不另拆计。
